tips: Focus script writing on high-performing business types like mobile phone shops, jewellery shops, cafes, and car workshops while avoiding travel agencies, schools, and restaurants.
Utilize Arabic and Urdu languages heavily as they outperform English significantly in video engagement.
Prioritize Reels and long promo videos over static pictures and English text hooks which showed zero or extremely low views.
Emphasize digital transformation, modern store upgrades, and comprehensive business solutions in the title styles rather than mentioning any prices.
Conclude every script with a strong, direct call to action directing business owners to WhatsApp for increased inquiries and sales.
